nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address used by the two-step transferOwnership/acceptOwnership flow.
Mapping of token holder balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender allowances; mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Fixed token supply set once in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Token symbol, set to MCC in the constructor.
Token name, set to 'LWR MCC ERC20 Token' in the constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor and used in supply computation.
Constructor that initializes symbol, name, decimals and the entire supply to the owner.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
Returns the token balance of a given owner address.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath add/sub.
Sets the allowance of a spender for msg.sender.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decreases the caller's allowance.
Returns the remaining allowance of a spender for a token owner.
Sets an allowance and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract in the same transaction.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH.
onlyOwner escape hatch that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
onlyOwner function that stores the pending new owner.
Completes ownership transfer when called by the pending new owner.
Library addition with an overflow check via require(c >= a).
Library subtraction with an underflow check via require(b <= a).
Library multiplication with an overflow check.
Library division that requires a non-zero divisor.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowances, sender balances and access control checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after allowance state update.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary, attacker-supplied address.
Destination address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
Token amount parameter of transfer, approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Spender address parameter of approve, allowance and approveAndCall (also the external call target).
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Arbitrary calldata bytes forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary token contract address parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
Owner address parameter of balanceOf and allowance.
Pending owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Local return variable of the SafeMath library arithmetic functions.
Unchecked multiplication 5000000 * 10**uint(decimals) performed in the constructor outside SafeMath.

edges.reason: msg.sender is implicitly assigned to the owner state variable when the contract is deployed.
Constructor writes the computed total supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor credits balances[owner] with the full _totalSupply.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Constructor executes an unchecked multiplication to derive the supply.
Result of the unchecked arithmetic is stored in _totalSupply.
tokens parameter flows into the transfer routine.
to parameter is used as the transfer destination.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for balance debiting.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for balance crediting.
spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve.
approve writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender and spender.
tokens parameter becomes the approved allowance value.
from parameter is used as the debited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is used as the transferred amount in transferFrom.
to parameter is used as the credited account in transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping of the caller.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
tokenOwner parameter keys the balances lookup in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
totalSupply uses SafeMath.sub.
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowance lookup.
spender parameter keys the allowance lookup.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
spender parameter is the allowance key and external call target in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is the allowance value and forwarded amount in approveAndCall.
data parameter is user-supplied bytes handled by approveAndCall.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external interaction.
approveAndCall transfers control to an arbitrary external contract via receiveApproval.
spender address determines the external contract that is called.
user-supplied data bytes are forwarded into the external call.
The external callee can re-enter approveAndCall (or other token functions) before it returns.
tokenAddress parameter selects which contract will be called by the owner function.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on tokenAddress.
tokenAddress is the arbitrary target of the external transfer call.
The external transfer sends the recovered tokens to the owner address.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership updates the pending owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferring ownership.
onlyOwner modifier gates the arbitrary external call in transferAnyERC20Token.
acceptOwnership promotes the pending owner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership resets the newOwner state variable to address(0).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited account without further authorization.
approve keys the allowance on the caller-controlled msg.sender.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
approveAndCall keys the allowance on msg.sender and passes it to the external callee.
Local variable c carries the value returned from SafeMath.add.
SafeMath.add writes its computed sum into the local variable c.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' destination parameter exists only to feed the transfer routine and has no independent security role.
The 'tokens' amount parameter is a transient input consumed by the transfer logic.
The 'spender' parameter is only meaningful as the key written by approve.
The 'from' parameter is a transient account argument of transferFrom.
The 'data' bytes argument is only used by approveAndCall when forwarding to the external contract.
The 'tokenAddress' parameter is only used to select the external call target inside transferAnyERC20Token.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter is a transient lookup key for the balance reader.
The '_newOwner' parameter only exists to update the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership.
Local variable c is a temporary result holder inside the SafeMath.add routine.
